methodology: Index, December of the previous year = 100 -- 105.7 for July 2026, cumulative inflation so far this year and the form Kazakhstan's own commentary usually quotes. Same Taldau move as CPI. Before 2011: 1991-01 onward from BNS's printed history (December 1992 3060.8, 1993 2265.0, 1994 1258.3). History: 1991-01..2010-12 (240 months) from BNS's printed history (data/reference/bns_cpi_history.csv, scripts/load_cpi_history.py), equal to Taldau on all 11 months both carry (2011-12..2021-12).
